purpose: simple sequential baselines that complex role-preserving models must beat on the lead-time/false-alarm frontier

baselines.definition: adverse move from current regime extreme reaches 0.50 of the frozen k=3.0 volatility-normalized break threshold before confirmation
baselines.role: mechanical price-path early-warning baseline; shares the price path with the event label and is not independent predictive evidence

baselines.definition: frozen FAST state no longer robustly supports the current sequential regime
frozen FAST state is robustly opposite the current sequential regime
frozen SLOW state is robustly opposite the pre-break regime/new-regime direction
baselines.role: confirmation-delay baseline; not expected to maximize pre-break lead

baselines.definition: frozen BOCPD_RETURN_SUCCESSOR_V1 ADVERSE_BREAK_CANDIDATE from the previous completed month only
baselines.role: slow downside regime-break context; direction vote remains forbidden

comparison_rule: no single accuracy metric; compare the Pareto frontier of recall, false alarms and lead time. A more complex model must improve at least one primary dimension without materially degrading the others, then survive the locked retrospective challenge/stress and later prospective shadow.
